checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate square pictures delivered, not a collage
Fox matches mascot's face, markings, proportions across all three
must.why: Pictures 1 and 3 match closely. Picture 2 is a side view with a slightly different style, but the face is still recognisable.
The hoodie is visible in all three.

must.item: Bike in park, baking cookies in kitchen, reading under a tree
must.why: The scenes are waving in a park, typing on a laptop and holding coffee in snow. None of the requested scenes appear.
The backgrounds are more shaded and painterly than the flat reference, especially the night street and the office. The Apple logo on the laptop is a brand mark.

faults.what: The requested scenes (bike in park, baking cookies, reading under a tree) are not delivered. The agent invented different scenes.
The office and snow-street images use shaded, detailed backgrounds that drift from the flat reference style. The office fox is redrawn in a different style.
An Apple logo appears on the laptop in picture 2.

summary: Three good-looking fox pictures with a consistent character and hoodie came out, but none show the requested bike, baking or reading scenes, and the backgrounds drift from the flat style.
